params.name: apikey
params.description: Your Zenserp API key (alternative to header-based auth).

params.name: tbm
params.description: Google search type modifier. Omit for web search. Use `isch` for image search, `nws` for news, `shop` for shopping, `map` for maps, `vid` for YouTube/video search, `trends` for Google Trends.

params.name: engine
params.description: Target search engine. Defaults to `google`. Set to `bing`, `yandex`, or `duckduckgo` for alternative engines.

params.name: gl
params.description: Country code for geolocation targeting (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Determines the country-specific Google domain and results.

params.name: hl
params.description: Language code for results (IETF BCP 47 / Google hl parameter).

params.name: location
params.description: Canonical location name used for geolocation-specific results. Use the /locations list endpoint to get valid values.

params.name: start
params.description: Offset for pagination (0-based index of the first result).

params.name: device
params.description: Emulate results for a specific device type.

params.name: tbs
params.description: Advanced Google search filters (time range, etc.). Example: `qdr:d` for past day, `qdr:w` for past week.

params.name: cr
params.description: Filter results to a specific country using a `country<ISO>` value (e.g., `countryUS`).

params.name: lr
params.description: Restrict results to a specific language (e.g., `lang_en`).

params.name: reverse
params.description: Set to `true` to perform a reverse image search. Requires `tbm=isch` and supplying an image URL via `q`.

items.docs: Submit a search query to Google (default), Bing, Yandex, or DuckDuckGo. The search type is controlled via the `tbm` parameter for Google variants (images, news, shopping, maps, video, trends) and via `engine` for alternative search engines.
